title: Green Bonds: Reputational Bonding via Media Coverage
eligible_reason: Staggered binary adoption: first green bond issuance at firm-specific years (issuance cohorts 2013-2021 within the 2010-2021 panel; Table 1B lists 403 CDP issuers with first issuance 2010-2022) with matched never-issuer controls. Main-text Tables 4, 5, 6A, 8 (cols 1-2) and Figure 1 regress outcomes on allpost (static) or on relative-time indicators (event study) with firm-in-group FE and matched-group x year FE, no covariates, clustered by matched group. Matched-group x year FE is a time-invariant group interacted with calendar-time FE (allowed by PROTOCOL Sec. 2); lead may want to confirm that pair-by-year FE is acceptable since each matched group holds one treated and one control firm.
design_notes: Firm-year panel 2010-2021 built from CDP universe merged with Bloomberg/CBI green bond issuance, RavenPack media counts, Datastream financials, MSCI ESG. Matching (codes for cleaning data MS.do lines 263-326): mahapick Mahalanobis matching of each issuer (observed at t=-1) to non-issuers within the same GICS industry x year on 4 financials, 3 MSCI scores, news_env_log, legal origin, and 1-year changes; best match kept (_matchnum==1), pairs with _score<20 kept, each pair expanded to 2010-2021 and merged to firm-year data. Treatment allpost = issuer x (year >= greenbondyear). Regressions: reghdfe y allpost, absorb(id_cdp#msm_group_i year#msm_group_i) vce(cluster msm_group_i). Event-study columns use postpre1/post0/post1plus; Figure 1 uses bins -4+...2+ with -1 omitted. Table 6B/7 split allpost by cross-sectional characteristics (ineligible), Table 8 cols 5-6 are IV. N=5,322 firm-years in the news regressions.
estimators_reported: TWFE static (reghdfe, matched sample, group-firm and group-year FE)
TWFE event study (3 bins in Tables 4-6; 7 bins in Figure 1)

screener_notes: Screened from package only. allpost is not created in the shipped cleaning code (it is used at lines 307, 362-363 and labelled at 399), so its exact construction is inferred from the data dictionary ('indicator for years greater than and including greenbondyear') and from postpre1/post0/post1plus, which are zero for controls. The event-study columns include a t=-1 lead indicator (postpre1); treated as an event-study bin, not an extra treatment regressor.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Issuance years 2013-2021 have post-period observations in the 2010-2021 panel (Table 1B: 2013:4, 2014:14, 2015:18, 2016:14, 2017:35, 2018:45, 2019:65, 2020:67, 2021:113 issuers in the CDP universe; matched sample smaller). 2010 (1 firm) and 2022 (27) cohorts have no pre or no post periods.
data_files_note: Underlying data are licensed (RavenPack, Datastream/Asset4, MSCI ESG, CDP, Bloomberg, TruValue). Only code, logs and output tables are shipped.
software_notes: StataMP 17; reghdfe, ivreg2, mahapick, estout, labmask, grstyle
priority_note: Eligible design and clean specs, but no analysis data in the package; would require author outreach or licensed data.
